question: What fish evidence do the 2018 and 2023 SNMC EPRMPs support for named Bulacan freshwater sites, and can any report-derived record be admitted as a current, verified species occurrence?

studyRelationship.assessment: These are separate EPRMP assessments for the same proponent's quarry expansion project area in Bulacan. The 2018 report describes a 2006 six-site freshwater survey; the 2023 report describes a May 2022 assessment at four Conlong and Salapangan River stations.
studyRelationship.independence: No retrieved field logs or report text establish whether the later assessment rechecked, replaced, or independently sampled any of the 2006 sites. Do not combine their lists or treat them as independent confirmation of the same station-level occurrence.

reports.citation: Solid North Mineral Corporation. (2018). Environmental Performance Report and Management Plan: SNMC Quarry Expansion & 1.5 MMTPY Limestone Pulverizing Plant, Barangay Akle, San Ildefonso, Bulacan. DENR-EMB EIA document repository.

reportedSurvey.methodAsReported: The report says identification was based on actual identification and interviews with people around the river; it does not state the evidence mode for each listed taxon.
reportedSurvey.coordinates: None reported in the reviewed text.
reportedSurvey.reportedFishCountConflict: The prose names seven fish taxa, while the table text lists ten vertebrate/fish rows. The report also calls the table 'Updated', but dates the underlying six-site survey to 2006 and gives no separate update date.
reportedSurvey.tableCellDisposition: No fish-to-station X matrix was transcribed. The indexed text is not a rendered page, so column alignment and blank cells were not visually verified.
reportedSurvey.taxonomyDisposition: All ten names are retained verbatim. Several spellings or combinations require taxonomic crosswalk; no source string was silently corrected or normalized.
reportedSurvey.localityDisposition: Station and barangay labels are preserved as printed. No coordinates or defensible canonical stream/reach links were established; do not merge these labels with similarly named Akle or Garlang features elsewhere.

reports.decision: Historical source lead only. Hold the full fish list and every apparent station assignment pending visual table access, taxonomic review, evidence-mode clarification, and rights review.

reports.citation: Solid North Mineral Corporation. (2023). Environmental Performance Report and Management Plan: SNMC Quarry Expansion Project, San Ildefonso and Doña Remedios Trinidad, Bulacan. Prepared by LCI Envi Corporation. DENR-EMB EIA document repository.

reportedAssessment.dateLimit: The date range is for the freshwater assessment; the exact observation date for each fish station is not provided.

fishEvidence.methodsAsReported: The report says freshwater fish and other-fauna data were gathered through interviews and secondary reports/articles. Its fish section says the other aquatic fauna were observed but were not sampled.

fieldObservationCandidates.observationAsReported: Guppies were described as numerous at the listed stations.
fieldObservationCandidates.status: Historical report-named visual-observation candidate; not captured or vouchered in the report.
Unidentified fish observation; no species-level claim.

fishEvidence.interviewAndSecondaryLeads: The report says fish reported by interviewed local fishers included bulig and hito. It also lists Channa striata and Poecilia reticulata in a broader study-area species table, but no station-specific fish capture or specimen crosswalk is given for those entries.
fishEvidence.useLimit: The report's rainy-season catchability statement is an interview-reported historical observation, not current fishing advice or a catch recommendation.

reports.decision: Retain Poecilia reticulata only as a research candidate tied to the report's named visual observations at W02-W04 and the overall May 2022 assessment window. Do not add an app occurrence or claim current presence. Keep the W03 tilapia unidentified; keep interview and secondary taxa unassigned to stations.

rightsAndDisposition.itemSpecificReuseLicense: No item-specific open license or permission to redistribute report-derived data was verified for either EPRMP. Public access through the EMB portal is not treated as a reuse grant.
rightsAndDisposition.contentHandling: No report PDF, page image, table layout, map, fish photograph, or raw data file was downloaded or retained. Only short factual source summaries and source-name strings are recorded for internal research.

nextActions: Seek a lawfully accessible copy of the 2023 EPRMP or underlying observation records; verify the source-named Poecilia identification, exact per-station observation dates, and photo/specimen support before proposing any occurrence row.

Seek a lawfully accessible rendered copy of the 2018 EPRMP to inspect Table 2-15 visually, reconcile the seven-versus-ten fish count, and verify every station cell before any taxonomic or locality crosswalk.
Keep the 2006 and 2022 survey windows separate and do not treat the EPRMP reports as complete Bulacan freshwater inventories or evidence of current catchability, safety, access, or fishing legality.

sources.supports: Official EMB-hosted 2018 EPRMP indexed text for the 2006 six-station survey, station names, species-count conflict, and verbatim fish-name rows; direct PDF retrieval returned HTTP 403.

Official EMB-hosted 2023 EPRMP indexed text for the May 2022 Conlong/Salapangan assessment dates, station descriptions and coordinates, fish-data methods, observations, and interview/secondary evidence limits; direct PDF retrieval returned HTTP 403.
